tools.name: search_parking
tools.description: Find parking spaces, garages, driveways and car parks listed on Parksy near a place. Returns up to 10 listings with type, price as listed, distance, features and a "View listing on Parksy" link. For daily, monthly or hourly parking. Parksy does not take bookings: people contact the parking provider

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Public details of one Parksy parking listing: title, address, prices as listed (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly), space type, features, vehicle sizes, description and the "View listing on Parksy" link where the user can contact the parking provider. Use a listing_id from search_parking or a parksy.co

tools.description: Search Parksy parking guides and articles: free and cheap parking, parking rates, fines and appeals, towing, disability parking, permits, signs, street rules, car storage and moving day, for a city or suburb or in general. tools.name: sample_letters
tools.description: Lists Parksy sample letters for appealing a parking ticket (for example broken meter, not the driver, sold the car, paid but still fined, public holiday, apology), or returns the text of one letter with its page and PDF/TXT download links. Templates to adapt, not legal advice.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, fine_appeal_check · Private data: search_parking, get_listing, fine_appeal_check · Public sink: fine_appeal_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, fine_appeal_check · Private data: search_parking, get_listing, fine_appeal_check · Public sink: fine_appeal_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
